messages:
sam: deploy-bot blocked the canary for invoicing-service in eu-west — values checksum mismatch detected.

deploy-bot: preflight failure: values.checksum != expected. canary paused. reason: overlay changed (cpu/memory + feature flag). docs: https://ci.redwood/alerts/9021 :warning:

nina: I see a stray change to replicas and a debug flag `debug_retry=true` that slipped in from my branch. small but changed the hash.

sam: rollback will delay the whole promo queue. can we pin to chart v1.12.4 instead of rolling back? lower blast radius.

oncall-sre: I can monitor. if 5xx > 0.5% or latency P95 increases > 150ms within 10m, we rollback.

mike-pm: product prefers minimal disruption. pin if safe. add note to release notes.

nina: doing pin now: ```deploy-bot pin-chart invoicing-service --chart-version=1.12.4 --reason="accidental overlay debug flag" --actor=nina```

deploy-bot: pinned invoicing-service chart=1.12.4 by nina; canary retry started (id=40122). monitoring targets: p95 <= 130ms, 5xx <= 0.2%.

oncall-sre: 5m check good. continuing 10m watch.

deploy-bot: canary success; promoted. metrics stable.

sam: great. nina please add a note on the PR to target staging overlays next time. mike-pm, release notes updated with: "Chart pinned to 1.12.4 to mitigate accidental overlay change; debug flag deferred."

mike-pm: noted. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
